scope: iPhone 发热与掉帧定位后，按用户要求先减少持续负载；未降低帧率、分辨率或画质。

device.userObservation: 已经明显发热，但这段还算流畅

findings.evidence: Cocos 3.8.8 source and this phone source agree: three window queries for each touch event. 127/1381 JS stacks pass through the Cocos touch handler; 84/85 windowSize stacks belong to touch, one to the capture setup. The previous business viewport fix is present and does not cover this engine path.
findings.classification: confirmed redundant native calls; not measured GPU or thermal time

findings.path: ChapterGame.save -> SaveStore.write -> GameSession.snapshot / validateSnapshot / synchronous storage
findings.evidence: 168/1381 JS stacks pass through SaveStore.write. Existing path clones current enemies, stringifies/parses the whole state, validates, then stringifies the whole state again. Automatic saves remain every two seconds when dirty.
findings.classification: confirmed repeated serialization/validation; native IO remains synchronous

findings.evidence: 439/1381 stacks pass through Root.frameMove, 166 through UI.update. Baseline draw calls 132–190 and triangles 131939–183427.
findings.classification: remaining render workload, not proof of GPU saturation

profileBoundary: 15-second independent profile: mostly stationary, 129 moving frames and zero action frames. Inclusive sample counts overlap; zero device timestamps prohibit converting these fractions to CPU ms, power or thermal contributions. Selected Inspector target averaged 22.0% of one CPU core; not whole TapTap or whole-phone CPU.

changes.behavior: Cache documented platform window information before Cocos copies its functions. Register resize/foreground invalidation before engine listeners. Copy return values/safeArea, preserve native behavior for invalid values or unsupported hosts, provide exact cleanup. No Cocos getter or engine source patch.
Copy the project-owned cache adapter and install it once in the mini-game entry before engine import; reuse the official converter.

Serialize a save once; public snapshot still returns fully detached JSON data. Validate identical fields and depth/size rules with indexed loops instead of allocating Object.entries pairs/callbacks for every nested object.
Reuse serialized payload after validating its decoded snapshot. Double slots, revisions, checksum, read-after-write verification, two-second schedule, errors/retry and new-journey backups retained.

saveLocal.scope: Node on Mac, identical generated multi-area save; not iPhone thermal or native IO measurement

validation.phoneApiShape: Actual 0.3.43 phone runtime exposes all five documented callbacks/getter; window getter is writable/configurable. Read-only check; no platform API replacement was left installed on phone.

initialPayload.note: Offline ZIP of files outside declared subPackages; platform-delivered first package is not measured.

limits: No measured GPU utilization/GPU duration, temperature, power or thermal-state/frequency data.
Short-window GPU allocations and sampled JS category memory cannot prove absence/presence of a leak.
0.3.43 long low-FPS thermal state was not reproduced in the accepted windows; current recorded heat did not prevent near-60 FPS.
No claim of a measured temperature drop or iPhone-wide CPU percentage improvement from the new source.
Native async storage migration was not attempted; preserving save durability and lifecycle semantics takes precedence.
